title.tagline: She walks. We live on her. One day, our children will see the Source.
title.march_sub: Nine legs, three generations, alone or two on one screen
title.confirm_new: Abandon the current march and start over with the founders?
title.free_sub: A land, a level, a wild titan or not — alone or two
title.duel_sub: Against the AI or two on one screen
title.online_sub: An expedition together, or a duel

options.title: OPTIONS

setup.free_rules: A leg outside the great march. With two, the screen splits: player 1 on the left keyboard and mouse (WASD, Space, Shift, F, 1-5), player 2 on the arrows (Enter, /, ., 6-0) or a gamepad.
setup.duel_rules: Two colossi face to face. Strike when the other drops his guard, parry when he winds up, grab to hold him, brace against a grab. Balance falling to zero throws a titan down.

ash.name: The Ash Sea
ash.desc: Grey dunes as far as the eye can see, stranded hulls to salvage, chasms hidden under the ash. The safest road, and the longest.
ash.brief: The Ash Sea. No particular trap: wrecks, chasms, scavengers. Keep the heart warm.

ruins.name: The Sunken Ruins
ruins.desc: A city drowned in ash: many wrecks to hoist aboard, rockfalls between the towers, and flocks of scavengers nesting in the broken spires.
ruins.brief: The Ruins. Supplies everywhere, scavengers everywhere. Harpooners, to your posts.

forest.name: The Petrified Forest
forest.desc: White trunks as tall as towers, geysers that warm Ama's heart… and the pressure that rises with it. Few raiders venture there.
forest.brief: The Petrified Forest. The geysers heat the heart: watch the pressure, vent it before it bursts.

storm.name: The Black Storm
storm.desc: A shortcut through an ash storm: you can barely see a thing, Ama slows down and grows cold. The lookout is worth her weight in gold there.
storm.brief: The Storm. Pip, do not leave your tower. Everyone: we walk blind.

oasis.name: The Oasis
oasis.desc: An oasis: halting there, Ama drinks and heals, and the stores are filled again. But raiders know the way to water too.
oasis.brief: The Oasis. Halt in the water (pace: Halt) so she drinks and heals. And keep an eye on the horizon.

belier.name: The Ram
belier.desc: A wild titan with ram's horns, young and furious. He hits hard but often leaves himself open.
belier.brief: Le Bélier nous barre la route. Parez ses coups quand il arme son bras, saisissez-le, et que les harpons trouvent ses points faibles.

fournaise.name: The Furnace
fournaise.desc: An old lava titan with a burning heart. Tougher, cleverer: he parries and he grabs.
fournaise.brief: La Fournaise sort de la tempête. Elle saisit : ancrez Ama quand elle ouvre les bras.

roi.name: The Ash King
roi.desc: The greatest of the wild titans, warden of the road to the Source. Nothing has ever brought him down.
roi.brief: Le Roi des Cendres. Derrière lui, la Source. Tout ce que nos parents nous ont appris, c'est maintenant.

gen.1: 2nd generation — The Children of the Back

steady.name: Steady hand
steady.desc: Pilot: stronger blows (+15%), a longer parry.

stout.name: Stout
stout.desc: Gets up twice as fast after a fall.

brave.name: Brave
brave.desc: Drives raiders off twice as fast.

sub.1: Twenty years have passed on Ama's back. The founders have grown old; their children take the posts.
sub.2: One more generation. Those born during the march hand over to those who will see the Source.

result.done_sub: Ama stops for the night. Her wounds are dressed, the supplies counted.
result.won_sub: The wild titan collapses into the ash. Ama walks on, slower, prouder.
result.lost_sub: She will rise again, slowly. This leg must be walked again.
result.duel_lost_sub: Ama backs away from a stronger foe.
result.p2_won_sub: The wild titan holds the field.
result.scars: Ama keeps {n} points of scars: her maximum health drops by as much.
result.new_gen: The years go by. A new generation will take the posts.

online.title: ONLINE
online.rules: One hosts, the other joins with their address (port 47644 opens by itself when the router allows it). The host chooses: an expedition together on Ama — each their own character — or a titan duel.
online.waiting: Waiting for a player… Your address: {addr}
online.wait_host: The host is choosing the game…

leg: Welcome on Ama's back. Keys 1 to 5 take a post: 1 the head (pilot), 2 and 3 the harpoons, 4 the heart forge, 5 the lookout. The crew holds the others.
At the helm: <kbd>A</kbd>/<kbd>D</kbd> to veer, <kbd>W</kbd>/<kbd>S</kbd> for the pace (Halt, Walk, Stride). Hold <kbd>{act}</kbd> to brace Ama before a rockfall.
At the heart forge: <kbd>{act}</kbd> stokes (heat, for supplies), <kbd>{alt}</kbd> vents the pressure. Without heat Ama slows down; too much pressure and the heart bursts.
At the harpoons: the mouse aims, <kbd>{act}</kbd> fires. The harpoon locks onto the target nearest the reticle: scavengers, raider skiffs, wrecks to haul.
Without a post you walk the deck: hold <kbd>{act}</kbd> near a fire to beat it out, or near a raider to drive him off. Press your post's number again to step down. <kbd>{view}</kbd>: overview.

l1: Long ago the Ash Sea swallowed everything. Only we remain, and Ama.
Ama smells water, somewhere to the east. She wants to walk. We will walk with her.
I'm climbing the tower! I'll see the chasms before anyone else!
l2: The heart is holding. But we'll need supplies: every shovel of embers eats some.
The wrecks have full holds. A good harpoon, a rope, and we haul them up.
l3: Over there… something red is moving in the dust. Something huge.
A wild titan. He will not let us pass. Everyone to your post.
l4: Twenty years have passed. The children born on Ama's back have taken their parents' posts.
My mother used to say Ama was never afraid. I'm afraid enough for both of us.
l5: The pressure climbs faster than it used to. Ama is getting old too.
There are more raiders around here. Keep your spears close.
l6: The storm is rising… and something is burning inside it.
The Furnace. My mother saw her once, from afar. She turned back.
l7: One more generation. Those who saw Ama set out have become legends told by the fire.
They say the Source lies past the last mountains. We'll be there before I'm old.
l8: Ama is limping. Her scars pull at her. She has to hold on a little longer.
I can see white birds on the horizon. The elders said they live near water.
l9: He's there. The Ash King. He's bigger than Ama.
Then we'll be more stubborn than him. For our grandparents. For the Source.

intro.text: The Ash Sea has buried everything: the cities, the forests, the rivers. Only dust remains, and the wind.
And Ama. A titaness of stone and moss, slow and gentle, who has always walked. On her back we built a village.
In the middle beats her heart, a living forge. As long as we tend it, she walks. As long as she walks, we live.
She smells water, somewhere to the east: the Source the songs speak of. The journey will last longer than a life. Our children will finish it.

finale.text: At the end of the world, water springs from the cliff. Young titans drink there. Ama steps forward, and drinks.
Three generations stand on her head. The elders weep; the children laugh. No one remembers the first step, but everyone will remember this one.
Ama will walk no more. She has found the Source. And we, at last, can set our houses on solid ground.
